method: Price: prior close x (1 + median move to the high/low over the last 20 sessions); 80% band = 10th-90th percentile of that move over up to 60 sessions. Time: the modal 15-minute bar of past highs/lows (up to 60 sessions) with its probability; separately, the centre of the +/-60 min window holding the most probability (a window centre, not the likeliest time). Intraday revisions forecast the FINAL full-session high/low, including what already traded, from exactly the bars up to a fixed checkpoint, by replaying the rest of each earlier session from the same bar. Regular session only; NYSE holidays and half-days applied.

timing.basis: per past session (or replayed scenario): (early, late) = the earlier and later of the high and low bars; the reported pair is the most frequent such ordered pair (pPair); pBar/p60 are each bar's own share; pHighFirst = share of sessions where the high came first; pPairHighFirst = the same share among sessions that produced the selected pair

intraday.target: final full-session high and low of 2026-10-30, including bars already traded
